publication_review.acceptance_rule: README and manifest explicitly require actual delivery-process exit zero, no publication failure, final completion marker, its manifest SHA and every artifact SHA. Marker presence alone is insufficient, including if final directory fsync failed after the link.
publication_review.atomic_marker_only: The fully prepared completion receipt is copied with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW into completion.pending.json inside the final light CODE directory, verified against the original source byte count/SHA before and after copying, and fsynced. os.link then atomically creates completion.json from that pending file in the SAME directory without replacement, followed by directory fsync. No cross-area hard link, rename, automatic fallback or deletion occurs. Only the marker is atomic; directories can appear before completion.
publication_review.claim_and_reservation: Permanent exclusive-create claim is fsynced and bound by SHA/device/inode; each final directory uses exclusive mkdir. Existing directory, regular file or dangling symbolic link is refused without overwrite.
publication_review.exclusive_files: New destination files use O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW on Linux, copy complete bytes, flush/fsync and verify SHA and byte size. Directory device/inode identity is checked before/after copies. Original scientific inputs/results remain untouched.
publication_review.explicit_compatibility_revision: The original PFS NOREPLACE call failed EINVAL/22. The following explicit publication revision encountered TMP-to-CODE hard-link EXDEV/18 in a pure-file capability probe, before any actual delivery. The final reviewed implementation copies the completion receipt across areas then links only within the final CODE directory. Both historical source/review/test/probe scenes remain untouched.
publication_review.failure_retention: Failure keeps the permanent claim, staging, any partial final directories/files and phase/type/errno receipt. Successful staging is also kept. No deletion or automatic retry occurs.
publication_review.final_manifest_verification: Heavy files are published first, then light files excluding completion.json. Before the final link the directories are reidentified, published manifest SHA must equal the prepared completion receipt binding, and every manifest file is checked for bytes and SHA. Synthetic mutation of an already published heavy file stops before os.link.
publication_review.pending_receipt: completion.pending.json is preserved completion metadata, alongside the final hard-link marker; it is excluded from the payload manifest self-hash cycle. The marker, bound manifest and all payload hashes must validate, and the delivery process must actually exit zero without a publication failure receipt.
publication_review.storage_limit: The unchanged 10000000-byte repository limit and complete heavy CSVs in personal tmp remain. Completion/manifest do not falsely declare a standalone recovery package or R2.
publication_review.synthetic_coverage: Existing file/directory, symbolic-link lstat rejection, changed claim bytes/inode, duplicate final link, exact second-stage failure, unsupported link without fallback, heavy mutation, and post-link fsync failure are exercised. The symbol-link test mocks lstat and forbids open/is_file; it creates no PFS or local symbolic link. Final same-area test enforces identical source/destination parents for os.link and verifies pending/marker inode equality and exact receipt bytes.

required_before_actual_use: Root must run the frozen 32 synthetic tests in the original Linux CPython/PFS environment, with CUDA hidden and no scientific runtime access.
Actual R1 owner and all children must later be genuinely closed with successful waits and full authenticated ledgers before invoking delivery.
This review does not approve a scientific retry, changed model/strategy/budget, R2, or delivery based solely on a marker.
